name: Mau’s Hōkūleʻa navigation
summary: Micronesian navigator Mau Piailug guided Hōkūleʻa from Hawaiʻi to Tahiti in 1976 without instruments, showing that traditional wayfinding could make such a long voyage.
description: Mau Piailug guided Hōkūleʻa to Tahiti using noninstrument wayfinding.

why: The Polynesian Voyaging Society invited experienced Satawal navigator Mau Piailug to guide its 1976 voyage without instruments.
